parole.significato: Forming words pertaining to bringing lower (chiefly figuratively).
parole.testo: Related to the root כ־ר־ע with the second radical changing its manner of articulation. Gesenius connects this root to Proto-Indo-European *ǵónu (“knee”) and reconstructs its original meaning as related to bending or falling on one's knees.
